QuestInfo.name: The Lost Photo Album
QuestInfo.0: I think I lost the Official Aqua Road Photo Album that Muse gave me. I better go see her again.
QuestInfo.1: Muse said she can make another one for me, but this time, it'll cost me 10,000 mesos. 10,000 mesos? Man, that's expensive...
QuestInfo.2: I gave Muse 10,000 mesos for the Official Aqua Road Photo Album.
